description: Dispatch a workflow (workflow_dispatch): { repo, workflow: <file name or id>, ref?, inputs? } -> { output }. inputs become -f key=value pairs.

inputs.description: workflow_dispatch inputs, each passed as `-f key=value`.

ref.description: Branch or tag to run on (gh default: the repo default branch).

workflow.description: Workflow file name (e.g. "release.yml") or numeric id.

response_schema.description: Trimmed stdout of a mutating gh command (gh prints the created/updated URL or a confirmation line; some commands print nothing).
response_schema.title: TextResponse
